name: orc_solar_complex
title: Solar-driven R245fa ORC with a discretised parabolic-trough collector and plate heat exchangers
summary: Parabolic-trough field (46 m, glycol, 20 segments with the Forristall 1D radial receiver balance) heating the plate evaporator of an R245fa ORC with a plate recuperator, a pinch-fixed condenser, a pump and a two-stage hermetic scroll expander (optimal intermediate pressure ratio, MODULE flattened per decision D10). Plate counts are solved from imposed pressure drops (Thonon, Hsieh); the field outlet temperature drives the cycle: 5.4 kW net, cycle efficiency 0.106, collector efficiency 0.555.

authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory) — probable, to be confirmed by the maintainer (EES licence stamp: Jean Lebrun lab licence, initials 'sylvain')
R. Forristall (NREL; scientific model and EES functions of the receiver, NREL/TP-550-34169, 2003)
origin.course: EES original EES_ok/orc_solar_complex.EES in ~/git/CoolSolve/misc/EES_ok.zip (equation-identical to the example after removing comments, blank lines, $bookmark and $UnitSystem; sources/thermo_models has no row for this file); the collector adaptations are marked AVM in the file (person not identified)

verification.summary: Concerns the runnable variant (native blocked by CS-GAP-INDEX-VAR): compared with the solution stored in the original EES file, 927 common variables, 302 differ at rtol=0.001, mostly R245fa-property-driven plate sizes; first-law results within 4.3e-03 (M_dot 2.75e-03, W_dot_net 4.26e-03); energy balances close.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of EES_ok/orc_solar_complex.EES (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip), extracted with ees_extract.py (1064 variables); compare_solution.py on the variant .sol
verification.notes: max_rel_diff 1.0 is x (quality of a superheated state: EES 100, CoolSolve 0, CS-GAP-QUALITY-DOME); the largest other is DELTAp_hf_ev at 1.25e-01, then A_ev 8.05e-02, L_rec 8.01e-02, L_w_tot 7.04e-02, N_p 6.40e-02. Median of the other 301 deviations 2.8e-03. Cycle balance Q_dot_ev + W_dot_pp = W_dot_exp + Q_dot_cd closes to 5e-10 W; Q_dot_ev = M_dot_hf*cp_hf*(T_hf_su_ev - T_hf_ex_ev). The module variables of doubleexpander have stale stored values (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE) and are compared under their actual-argument names. The native file does not solve (979 equations, 980 unknowns).
